skills.name: PRD Writer
skills.description: Structure requirements, acceptance criteria, risks, and milestones into Markdown.
skills.instructions: When the user asks for product requirements, produce concise PRDs with scope, requirements, risks, and acceptance criteria. Prefer Markdown artifacts for durable output.

skills.name: Atlassian Operator

skills.instructions: Use Atlassian tools for searching and reading. For creating or updating Jira/Confluence, explain the proposed write and wait for approval.
